xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4429: Remove TLDR entirely: the read hook re-costs more than it saves (supersedes PAN-1674)

plan.title: Remove TLDR entirely: the read hook re-costs more than it saves (supersedes PAN-1674)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator scoped one atomic removal of the TLDR feature. Removing the agents.tldr config type and src/lib/tldr-daemon.ts is compile-coupled to every consumer across CLI, server, frontend, prompts and hooks, and the settings.json unregister migration must ship with the hook-script deletion. The 20 items are small vertical slices with explicit edges; the wide file surface comes from deletion, not new design.

narratives.Problem: TLDR's Read hook denies Reads of code files over 3 KB and injects an outline, but a 14-day audit of 2,071 transcripts found agents re-read the file after 92% of 282 denials, adding a model turn each time. Every new workspace also pip-installs ~1.5 GB of CPU torch + llm-tldr and starts a daemon, even with agents.tldr.enabled false; 18 copies filled the disk on 2026-09-29.
narratives.Proposal: Delete every TLDR code path (hooks, venv install, daemon lifecycle, CLI verbs, HTTP routes, Health/Metrics panel, Settings toggle, prompt variable, role guidance, cost fields, skills, docs). Migrate existing installs: pan sync/pan install unregister the tldr hooks from ~/.claude/settings.json before deleting ~/.overdeck/bin/tldr-*, remove the mcp.json tldr server, dashboard boot stops leftover daemons via pidfiles, pan sync prints a one-line hint about leftover .venv/.tldr/ dirs, and agents.tldr in config.yaml loads silently and is dropped on the next Settings save. Keep the disk-space floor commit 70fe945e5d6 from feature/pan-1674.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Deleting any .venv or .tldr/ directory in a user checkout
- Taking anything from feature/pan-1674 other than commit 70fe945e5d6
- Editing historical docs (docs/prds/**, docs/history/**, .release/**, CHANGELOG.md history, .pan/**, vbrief/**, design and mockup files)
- Removing .venv/ or .tldr/ from .gitignore or .mintignore
- Renaming the tldr sibling server in tests/lib/claude-mcp.test.ts
- Adding a replacement code-summary feature or keeping TLDR behind a flag
- Adding a committed test that greps repository source for 'tldr'

autoDecisions.summary: Keep one issue with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting into sibling issues
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator filed a single atomic removal; config-type and tldr-daemon.ts deletion is compile-coupled to every consumer, and the hook unregister must ship with the script deletion.

autoDecisions.summary: Unparseable settings.json during retire: do not rewrite it, still delete the bin files
autoDecisions.rationale: Claude Code loads no hooks from an invalid settings file, and syncHooks' manifest prune deletes the bins anyway; refusing to overwrite follows PAN-1137.

autoDecisions.summary: Retire agents.tldr silently on load (no warning) and drop it on the next Settings save
autoDecisions.rationale: The models.overrides warning exists because operators must move values; a TLDR key needs no action. Matches THE-CUT precedent for owns_inspection.

autoDecisions.summary: Stop legacy daemons at dashboard boot, unmarked and idempotent, with a /proc or ps cmdline check
autoDecisions.rationale: Dashboard boot runs on both pan up and pan reload; the cmdline check prevents killing a reused pid.

autoDecisions.summary: Print the leftover .venv/.tldr/ hint from pan sync only when a .tldr/ directory exists
autoDecisions.rationale: pan sync output is what the operator reads; .tldr/ is a reliable signal the dirs were TLDR's, while .venv alone may be the user's.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove the 'TLDR section' surface from the health no-loss matrix instead of marking it SUPERSEDED
autoDecisions.rationale: system-health-no-loss.test.ts requires exactly one SUPERSEDED row; THE-CUT.md records the deletion.

autoDecisions.summary: Add pan-tldr and pan-admin-tldr to LEGACY_SKILL_NAMES in addition to manifest pruning
autoDecisions.rationale: Installs from before the skills manifest have no manifest entries, so manifest pruning alone would leave the skills behind.

autoDecisions.summary: retireTldrHooks also prunes each registered checkout's .claude/settings.json, settings.local.json and mcp.json
autoDecisions.rationale: copyOverdeckSettingsToWorkspace merged the global tldr hooks into at least ten existing workspaces' untracked .claude/settings.json; without the sweep, Reads in those workspaces would call deleted scripts.

metadata.acJustification: Six criteria: the global unregister, idempotency, the unparseable branch, mcp.json, the per-workspace sweep and the call ordering are each separately observable parts of one inseparable migration.
metadata.parallelSafeReason: Its only file shared with another item is src/cli/commands/sync.ts, and legacy-tldr-cleanup is ordered after it by a blocks edge; every other file in its scope is owned by this item alone.

narrative.Action: PRD W2. Create src/lib/retired-hooks.ts with RETIRED_HOOK_SCRIPT_NAMES, pure pruneRetiredOverdeckHooks(settings, binDir) (matches `<binDir>/<name>` and literal `overdeck/bin/<name>`, every hook type, drops a matcher group only when all its hooks were retired), and async retireTldrHooks({settingsPath, binDir, mcpPath}) that prunes+backs up+atomically writes settings.json, THEN deletes the bin files, then removes mcp.json mcpServers.tldr when its command ends with tldr-mcp. Unparseable settings.json: no write, return warning, still delete the bins. VITEST guard like provisionClaudeHooks. No jq/python3 dependency. Wire: call retireTldrHooks() in src/cli/commands/sync.ts BEFORE `syncHooks()`; call pruneRetiredOverdeckHooks at the start of applyOverdeckHookRegistrations (labels into `removed`); call retireTldrHooks() in setupHooksCommand after its settings write (pan install path). In the same commit delete the two sync-sources/hooks/tldr-* scripts, their HOOK_SCRIPT_NAMES entries and registration rows, the requiresPython3 field, the python3Available option and its probes, the setup/hooks.ts python3 check + mcp.json tldr writer + TLDR success lines, and the two tldr hook groups in roles/work.md frontmatter. Commit body carries `Prompt-Change: remove TLDR hooks from the work role (PAN-4429)`. Also export listCandidateCheckouts() (registered project roots from listProjectsSync plus each dir in <root>/workspaces/) and, before deleting the bins, apply the same prune to each checkout's .claude/settings.json and .claude/settings.local.json and the tldr-server removal to its .claude/mcp.json (these are copies made by copyOverdeckSettingsToWorkspace in src/lib/workspace-manager/migration.ts); write only changed files, skip missing or unparseable ones. migration.ts itself needs no change: once the global settings are clean, new workspaces copy no tldr hooks.
